parsed.notes: Subject is the Pharos protein row (protein_id), resolved to its NCBI Gene. Object is the disease: mondoid is preferred when present (about 45% of rows), otherwise the UMLS CUI in did, which is already a compact CURIE. The name column is the disease label. Predicate is the most specific Biolink gene-disease predicate, gene_associated_with_condition. DisGeNET's score and evidence (PubMed/SNP counts) are carried as edge properties rather than used as a filter. The source column lists the contributing databases (CTD, Orphanet, ClinGen, PsyGeNET and others), which mix curated and text-mined sources, so knowledge_assertion with manual_agent is a best fit, not an exact one. Empty fields (zscore, conf, pvalue and similar) are not mapped.
